caption: The drawing features a rectangular page bordered by an ornate, colorful frame. The frame is decorated with detailed illustrations of grapevines, including curling tendrils, clusters of red and white grapes, and large leaves in shades of yellow, orange, and green, with visible veins. The grapevines form an intricate pattern along all four sides of the frame, intertwining with swirling blue elements and a red background that enhances the vibrant foliage. Inside the frame, there is a block of text written in black gothic script on a white background, with notable capital letters in red and blue near the beginning of paragraphs. A horizontal red bar highlights a section near the bottom of the text. The composition has a symmetrical, illuminated manuscript style, with naturalistic botanical detail dominating the border and a clear, structured central area for the text.
title: Illuminated Parable: The Sower
